advice.good: Air quality is ideal. Enjoy outdoor recreation and ventilate indoor spaces safely.
advice.moderate: Air quality is acceptable. Unusually sensitive individuals should consider limiting prolonged outdoor exertion.
advice.unhealthy_sensitive: Members of sensitive groups (asthma, heart disease, children, elderly) should wear an N95 mask and limit outdoor exercise.
advice.unhealthy: Everyone may begin experiencing health effects. Avoid prolonged outdoor activity, keep windows shut, and run air purifiers.
advice.very_unhealthy: Health alert: serious risk of harm for all citizens. Stay indoors, seal room drafts, and operate continuous HEPA filtration.
advice.hazardous: Health emergency: entire population is severely affected. Remain strictly indoors and avoid any physical exertion outdoors.

pm2_5.name: PM2.5
pm2_5.description: Inhalable particles ≤ 2.5 µm that penetrate deep into the lungs and enter the bloodstream.

pm10.name: PM10
pm10.description: Particles ≤ 10 µm including road dust, pollen, mold, and construction particulates.

ozone.name: Ozone (O₃)
ozone.description: Secondary pollutant created by photochemical reactions between sunlight and VOCs/NOx.

about.title: About Vayu
about.description: Vayu is a lightweight, frontend-only air quality assistant designed for urban citizens. Built for transparency, accessibility, and zero-barrier access with no logins or API keys required.
about.feature1Desc: Transparently fetches data from the Open-Meteo Atmospheric Chemistry & Geocoding models.
about.feature2Desc: Fully localized in English, Hindi, and Marathi with high contrast and keyboard navigation.
about.feature3Desc: Everything runs directly in your browser. No cookies, no logins, no cloud databases.
